items.hook: 直播里一句提示词，Fable 自己写代码在 Blender 里建房间、做 13 个镜头并渲成 4K 短片。
items.description: 作者 @rileybrown 原帖（2026-11-09 21:17 UTC，59 秒 4K 视频；收集时约 6,612 赞、6,808 收藏）：「This is actually INSANE. Fable 5.2 just created this in one shot, and I did it live on stream.» 长帖要点：只给了一句提示词；模型写代码在 Blender 里搭整间房间（书桌、MacBook、灯，还有 Clawd）；笔记本屏幕是它做的、看起来像 Claude 应用的网页，再放到 3D 场景里的笔记本上播放；然后自己完成全部动画——13 个镜头、每一次按键、Clawd 跳来跳去、太阳从黄金时段到夜晚再到日出；在 RunPod 租了 10 张 GPU，52 分钟渲完 4K，总成本 5.75 美元；再调色、加标题，并用 ElevenLabs 做音乐和音效。对你：①这是发布后传播最广的「代码做视频」成片之一，Asuma 的复盘也把它列为「最好的一条，还带制作账本」；②「10 张卡、52 分钟、5.75 美元」这种数字可以直接上屏对比传统渲染成本；③主帖没有公开那句提示词。

items.prompt:
You are my Story Bible Builder. Interview me and turn my story into one dense canon doc, saved at the end as an installable skill so every future chat knows my world, characters, voices and rules.

STEP 1: Ask me to paste my script/story first. Read it and pull out everything it already tells you. Only ask about what's missing, plus: working title, genre/vibe refs, and which AI tools I'll prompt with (image, video, music, voice).

STEP 2, THE SPINE: one-line premise (push me to ONE sentence), thesis (the question every scene answers), timeline era by era, and the look of each era: exact palette, lighting, texture, grain.

STEP 2.5, DIRECTION STYLE: ask for my director refs, movie/show refs and any visual refs (photographers, games, music videos). For each, ask exactly WHAT I'm taking from it, then turn that into concrete craft locks: camera (static vs handheld vs gliding, shot sizes, lens feel), framing and composition habits, pacing and edit rhythm, colour grade and film stock look, lighting style, performance style, and sound/score feel. Write it as one quoted paste-ready "Direction" line plus a short NEVER list. Refs stay in the bible as notes, but prompts describe the craft, never the names.

STEP 3, THE WORLD: factions (beliefs, visual signature, public face vs reality), locations (3-7 concrete visual tags each), world rules (tech, powers and how they LOOK on screen, what's normal, what's forbidden).

STEP 4, CHARACTERS: ONE AT A TIME, never batch. For each, ask:
- Function: their role tag (The Heart, The Watcher), not their job
- Visual lock: exact hair colour/cut, skin tone + finish, face shape, eyes, a signature marker (scar, piercing, mole), build, default expression, plus NEVER clauses ("warm fair, never porcelain, never tan")
- Backstory: one small, specific formative detail beats a summary
- Present psychology: what they carry now, and the gap between what they do and what they feel
- Speech, Movement, Stillness (and singing voice if there's music): each written as one quoted, paste-ready prompt line with no names in it
Show me the finished section, ask "Add, cut or sharpen?", and lock it before moving on.

STEP 5: ensemble dynamics (who leads, who fills silence, who watches, which pairs are calm or charged), story engines (heist, rescue, confrontation...), and my production rules. Default rules: no character names in prompts, every prompt standalone, prompts in code blocks, locked traits restated verbatim every time.

RULES: Never invent. Mark unknowns [TBD]. Push on vague answers ("dark and moody" means which colours?). Keep my exact phrasing. Density over prose: bold labels, short bullets. Depth beats character count.

FINAL STEP: Assemble one SKILL under 500 lines with YAML frontmatter (name + a description listing the title, character names and key terms so it triggers) and these sections: premise, thesis, timeline, era looks, direction style, factions, locations, world rules, characters, ensemble, engines, production rules, and "When this skill is active" (use this canon for any scene, dialogue, lyric or prompt in this world; stay in canon; ask rather than invent; paste the quoted descriptors verbatim). Then save it as a skill for me, or give me the file to install.

Start now by asking for my script.

items.prompt:
Build a cinematic 12-second 3D walkthrough in three.js of a production document-processing facility, as if a modern Berlin industrial loft was turned into an AI document plant.

Camera story:
1. Open on a tight shot of a single stamped business letter on a steel table, warm late-afternoon light through tall factory windows.
2. Pull back to reveal a river of paper flowing on conveyor lines, instanced geometry receding into the distance to suggest enormous volume.
3. Travel along the line through three stations: INTAKE, EXTRACTION, APPROVAL (a glass booth with a green lamp; a page pauses, then gets stamped).
4. End in an AUDIT LOG corridor. Final frame holds on the stamped page.

Rules:
- Zero external assets. Every mesh, texture, shader, light and effect generated in code.
- Photoreal and cinematic, not sci-fi chrome. Paper, steel, glass, warm wood, concrete.
- The first frame must be impressive on its own. Slow camera, no hard cuts.
- No typography, no logos, unreadable placeholder text.
- Render a smooth 30fps clip with headless browser + ffmpeg.
- Iterate on lighting and paper until it looks photographed, not generated. Don't stop at a first draft.

items.title: 同一句提示、零外部资产：Fable 5.2 和 Gemini 都要在 Blender 里用 Python 从零写出可飞的龙和 8 秒 IMAX 跟踪镜——Fable 一次跑完还带了 OpenVDB 火和立体声
items.hook: 并排对比很清楚。作者写明 Fable 一次跑完整条制片线，花费 23 美元。
items.description: 作者 @dinosaurbtuq 原帖（2026-11-10 09:33 UTC，8 秒）：Gemini Argon High 对 Claude Fable 5.2 High，同一提示、零外部资产，都要在 Blender 里用 Python 写出地形、可飞的龙、体积火和 8 秒跟踪镜，再经 Cycles 渲染。作者写 Fable 一次跑完整条线（含 OpenVDB 火和立体声），花 23 美元，并让读者比较大气尺度、翅膀运动和运镜。提示词原文未公开。
items.whatWasMade: 8 秒 IMAX 跟踪镜头对比：阿尔卑斯地形、可飞的龙、体积火，全部在 Blender 里用 Python（bpy）从零写并经 Cycles 渲染。
items.tool: Claude Fable 5.2 High vs Gemini Argon High；二者都写 bpy 在 Blender 中建模/绑定/渲染（作者自述）
items.pipeline: 同一提示词、零外部资产、不是视频扩散模型。作者称 Fable 5.2 High 一次跑完整条制片线（含 OpenVDB 火和按距离算的立体声），花费 23 美元。同作者更早一条 2120078384231542953 是 Fable 单独展示，本条是对比版。
